title: Harbinger is building the unsexy EVs that keep the economy moving
summary:
While legacy automakers tap the brakes on electric vehicles, one startup is hitting the accelerator.
Harbinger CEO John Harris got his start at Faraday Future before moving on to Xos Trucks and then Palmer Luckey’s Anduril.
Image: Harbinger“In auto, you have Class 1 companies and you have Class 8 companies,” Harris says.
Harris himself spent a year at tumultuous Chinese EV company Faraday Future before moving on to Xos Trucks and then Palmer Luckey’s Anduril.
Harbinger isn’t just building delivery trucks — it’s also branching into energy storage and military technology.

title: Why small businesses are staying optimistic, even as costs rise and AI takes hold
summary:
More than half of owners (52%) raised prices in the past year, according to Gusto's latest State of Small Business report.
Nich Tremper, Gusto's principal economist, shared three takeaways about the state of small business today.
AI is moving beyond the experiment phaseMost small businesses (67%) now use AI for at least some tasks.
"Small businesses are not immune to the cost pressures that everybody has felt the last couple years," Tremper said.
Even in an uncertain economy, "small business owners know that they are important in their community," Tremper said.

title: Intuit Sees Executive Departures Amid Stock Slides on AI Fears
summary:
Three senior leaders are leaving Intuit, including QuickBooks' general manager, according to an internal memo from last week that was obtained by Business Insider.
Intuit's chief architect Chris Kasten, a top engineering leader who oversees more than 1,700 employees, per his LinkedIn, is also leaving, Business Insider is the first to report.
The memo, from Intuit executive vice president Ashley Still, said that QuickBooks GM Arundhati Singh is leaving to pursue an "outside opportunity."
Want more Business Insider in your news feed?
Add to Preferred SourcesThose include Lance Williams, TurboTax's chief product officer; Julie Zimmerman, Intuit's customer experience director; and Karla Uribe, who led Intuit's AI accounting product.

title: Manappuram, Muthoot, IIFL Finance shares tumble up to 5% as gold hits 14-month lows. Why is the yellow metal losing its shine?
summary:
SynopsisShares of Muthoot Finance, Manappuram Finance and IIFL Finance fell on Friday as gold prices plunged to a 14-month low amid rising expectations of US Fed rate hikes and a stronger dollar.
